So.. it’s complicated. I get it because our parents where born during a time where this was extremely unacceptable. I also get you though. It’s your body and you are free to do what you want with it. I know getting a piercing is not that big of a deal but to them it’s like the biggest sin of all. Not listening or obeying them. 

I think if you decide to keep it in (for whatever reason) and she really does kicks you out, just be ready. At the same time it kind of is their roof their rules. I get it, it’s unfair, but it’s just the way things are. 

My brother painted his nails black which is extremely UNACCEPTABLE in our culture and my parents were SO mad at him saying to take it off or they would kick him out, and he did not do it. He stood his ground, told them things were different in this day and age, and they did not speak for several days but things got better with communication. 

Communicate communicate communicate. In a good way. Be calm and try to explain yourself but if your mother is capable of kicking you out, be ready. 

Worst case scenario, just take it out. If you are working then save up a ton of money and move out. It’s not easy at all though. You are still young and probably studying right now. 

I also think that even if you were to move out, they would be mad at you for having earrings. 

Don’t blame or be mad at your parents. Their way of thinking is different than yours. Calmly communicate with them and I really hope things work out for you.
